notes.title: First Closed Beta Version
notes.content:
🛠 Silent Spirits – Patch Notes
Update Highlights – Gameplay & Bug Fixes

Here’s what’s new in this update:

✅ Improvements
Customers now show a happy emoji after being served their drink.

When a glass is removed from the table, the customer’s "needs cleaning" status is cleared properly.

Happy emoji now fades out and disappears 5 seconds after appearing.

Glass colliders have been increased in size for better interaction.

Drink prices have been rebalanced.

Clean glasses are now set to Ignore Raycast to prevent unwanted interactions.

When a table enters the "waiting for cleaning" state, it checks for a glass before displaying the emoji.

🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where the "needs cleaning" emoji would remain stuck if the customer's patience ran out.

Customers who leave without drinking no longer appear drunk.

Fixed a bug where customers at the counter would leave happy immediately after arriving.

Resolved a logic issue where emoji feedback wasn’t reflecting cleaning state accurately.

🔄 QoL (Quality of Life)
Tables now indicate which one is prioritized for action to help player flow.

Thank you for playing Silent Spirits — more updates coming soon! 🍻
